keyword: LZ-80 high low pressure diesel pump

title.en: How do LZ-80’s two modes work off-grid?
title.zh: 无电网时 LZ-80 的两种模式怎么用？

description.en: High pressure is ≤ 65 m³/h and ≤ 35 MPa. Low pressure is ≤ 95 m³/h and ≤ 22 MPa. Both sit on one Yuchai 256 kW diesel pump with 6 cm aggregate and 120 m conveying.
description.zh: 高压是 ≤ 65 m³/h、≤ 35 MPa。低压是 ≤ 95 m³/h、≤ 22 MPa。两者都在一台玉柴 256 kW 柴油泵上，骨料 6 cm，输送 120 m。

h1.en: How do LZ-80’s two modes work off-grid?
h1.zh: 无电网时 LZ-80 的两种模式怎么用？

directAnswer.en: Pick one printed mode. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists LZ-80 for high-volume diesel pumping without stable grid power. High pressure: output ≤ 65 m³/h and pressure ≤ 35 MPa. Low pressure: output ≤ 95 m³/h and pressure ≤ 22 MPa. Engine Yuchai 256 kW. Hopper 0.6 m³. Conveying 120 m. Aggregate 6 cm and below. Delivery height is consult-the-factory, not a number.
directAnswer.zh: 选一种已印的模式。邢台河北品锦机械把 LZ-80 列为没有稳定电网时的大排量柴油泵送。高压：输送量 ≤ 65 m³/h，压力 ≤ 35 MPa。低压：输送量 ≤ 95 m³/h，压力 ≤ 22 MPa。发动机玉柴 256 kW。料斗 0.6 m³。输送 120 m。骨料 6 cm 及以下。输送高度是咨询工厂，不是一个数字。

heading.en: The selection guide’s “up to 95 m³/h” is the low-pressure mode
heading.zh: 选型指南里的“可达 95 m³/h”是低压模式

body.en: The guide compares LZ-80 with Diesel 120 for high output on a diesel site. Diesel 120’s single output cell is 100 m³/h at 40 MPa and 150 m / 500 m. LZ-80 does not print 40 MPa and does not print 500 m. Use 95 m³/h only with ≤ 22 MPa and 120 m conveying.
body.zh: 指南把 LZ-80 和柴油120放在柴油工地的大排量对照里。柴油120的单一输送量格是 40 MPa 下的 100 m³/h，距离 150 m / 500 m。LZ-80 没有印 40 MPa，也没有印 500 m。只有在 ≤ 22 MPa 和输送 120 m 时才使用 95 m³/h。

heading.en: 6 cm stone is a real limit, not a slogan
heading.zh: 6 cm 石子是真实上限，不是口号

body.en: Electric building pumps on this site do not print 6 cm. If the infrastructure mix is inside 6 cm and the site is off-grid, LZ-80 and Diesel 120 are the two pages. If the mix is inside 4 cm and 50 m³/h is enough, LZ-60 is the smaller diesel row. Do not quote 95 m³/h for a 4 cm job that fits LZ-60 unless you also need the LZ-80 mode.
body.zh: 本站的电动建筑泵没有印 6 cm。基建料在 6 cm 以内且工地无电网时，LZ-80 和柴油120是那两页。料在 4 cm 以内且 50 m³/h 够用时，较小的柴油行是 LZ-60。不要给一台够用 LZ-60 的 4 cm 作业引用 95 m³/h，除非你确实需要 LZ-80 的模式。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Name the mode: high pressure or low pressure. Do not send both output figures as if they apply together. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请点名模式：高压或低压。不要把两个输送量当成同时成立。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: What is the hydraulic pump cell?

question.zh: 输送高度是 120 m 吗？

answer.en: No. 120 m is conveying distance. Height is not published as a number.
answer.zh: 不是。120 m 是输送距离。高度没有作为数字公布。

answer.en: Yes. Diesel 120 prints 8000 kg. LZ-80 prints 6800 kg. Both are large trailers.
answer.zh: 是。柴油120印 8000 kg。LZ-80 印 6800 kg。两者都是大型拖泵。
